name: 34476 · Ocala, FL
findings: ZIP 34476 (Ocala) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34476 (Ocala) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 34476 (Ocala) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).
